limitations: Delivery is deliberately held after actual rasterization to make overlap deterministic.
Pending complete-frame retention delays visible viewport change until current results are ready.
Keyboard undo/save initially remained in the zoom control focus; canvas focus restored shortcuts.
Final later AX observation did not retain selection geometry; restored file hash is independently verified.
concurrent_workspace_note: At final review, dependency manifests/lockfiles and vendor sources had concurrent changes outside this task. They are preserved. Measurements use the single recorded executable hash; they are not a build/test claim for those later dependency changes. External background build activity is not established or excluded.
compiled_executable_validation: Release artifact used for all runs; own builds/tests finished before measurements. Source identities and runtime control behavior are recorded; later workspace dependency edits require their own build validation.
